name: VR StrideS Demo
summary:
# Move with your body

VR StrideS turns jogging in place into movement in VR. It reads motion from your headset and controllers, nothing else.

## Standalone demo

This free demo is fully standalone and offline:

- No PC, account, or internet connection
- One night forest trail
- Guided tutorial and a timed lap

Put on your Quest, set a clear boundary, and start jogging.
